summary: Export dependency and deployment wave graphs
description: Builds the local dependency graph and deployment waves, then exports review-ready graph artifacts in Mermaid, DOT, JSON, or HTML format.
examples: <%= config.bin %> smart-deployment graph export --format html --output reports/dependency-graph.html
flags.source-path.description: Path to the Salesforce source directory used to build the dependency and wave graph.
flags.report-dir.summary: Directory where the selected graph artifact is written
flags.report-dir.description: Defaults to .smart-deployment/reports/graph-export under the analyzed project root.
flags.output.summary: Exact output file path for the selected graph format
flags.output.description: Overrides --report-dir and writes the selected graph artifact to this file.
flags.format.description: Supported formats are mermaid, dot, json, and html.
flags.use-ai.summary: Use configured AI providers for dependency inference and wave priority analysis before exporting
flags.org-type.summary: Target org type used by AI wave priority analysis
flags.industry.summary: Industry context used by AI wave priority analysis
